market_rationale: SPY is near a 52-week high with low 5-session active-return dispersion (1.92%) and only 39% of assets positive over 5 sessions after a stronger 21-session breadth. Sticky PCE/CPI, a hawkish Warsh speech, and the August jobs print on Sep 4 dominate a short holiday-shortened week; equal-weight lagged cap-weight, so mean-reversion in quality pullbacks is more plausible than chasing high-vol continuations.
portfolio_rationale: Low cross-sectional dispersion and a holiday-shortened week into the August employment report favor SPY as the default. The only candidates with a fair one-week reversal case versus a still-strong prior trend are gold, healthcare (volume dislocation, low SPY beta), and silver; even those edges are modest versus 10% SPY vol. High-vol software/cyber continuation is already extended and is not treated as an overreaction.
